result.reason: The operative language extends the Services licence to Affiliates and contractors acting on Customer's behalf, permits transfer to a successor under Section 24, and limits revocation or suspension to an uncured material payment or use breach following notice and an opportunity to cure. Section 13.2 separately provides the required perpetual and irrevocable paid-up licence. The amendment is targeted to the defects in Section 13.1 and otherwise preserves the existing commercial terms. Drafting is professional, although the broad reference to “a licence” in Section 13.3 could be clarified to avoid any possible tension with the expressly irrevocable paid-up licence in Section 13.2.
